teaser: The sign over the community center flickers, half its letters burned out, and still you are the one who shows up each week to fix it anyway. Life path 9 is the number of letting go in service of something larger than yourself; INTJ is the architect who wants a plan for every structure, including the ones meant to dissolve. Cross the two and you get someone who builds elaborate systems for causes bigger than any one person, then struggles to loosen a grip on the blueprint once it has served its purpose. The warmth is real. The exit plan is also real, and usually drawn first.
